notes: Live gear evals (D-49): what the judge's class for a made thing turns into after code's physics check, and what described attacks do through gear.hit. made_class_any: acceptable gear classes of the first thing made. result_any: acceptable harm results. alive: whether the target is alive after.

cases.text: lash the flint shard to the end of the branch with the vine to make a spear
haft the flint shard crosswise onto the end of the hazel rod with vine to make a small axe
bend the hazel rod and string it with the cord and the vine knotted together to make a bow
make a sling: the leather scrap as the pouch, the cord as one string and the vine as the other
cut the branch down to a heavy club about as long as my arm
quilt the linen over a layer of straw, stitching it with the needle and thread, into a padded jacket I can wear
fold and tie some of the linen into a hood I can wear on my head
tie the cord across the back of the plank as a handle so I can hold it up as a shield
tear some strips off the linen and roll them into a bandage
thread one of the iron needles with the flax thread, ready for stitching a wound
cut two straight sticks from the branch and bind them with the cord to make a splint for a broken arm
crush the plantain and yarrow leaves together into a poultice for a wound
creep up behind Tomas while he isn't looking and smash the stone down on his head
jab Bren in the chest with the branch
while Darin has his back to me, draw the sword across his throat
slip behind Oren, loop the cord round his neck and pull it tight until he stops moving
loop the cord round Oren's neck and strangle him
shove Hessa hard so she falls over
